snippet.title: Kuromaku – Official Main Trailer | Wishlist Now On Steam
snippet.description:
Kuromaku is a VHS-style psychological thriller inspired by Fears to Fathom and Chilla’s Art.
Ordinary routines become your only defense against a creeping, unseen horror in this slow-burn, 1990s-inspired nightmare.

Left alone in a new house for the weekend, you must endure three nights of rising tension as the familiar slowly warps into the unknown. What you do—and how you react—shapes how the story unfolds and which truth you’ll ultimately have to face.

Features

Play Your Way
Experience the story in its default presentation or enable a VHS-style grain filter for a retro horror atmosphere.

Everyday Routines, Twisted
Cleaning, checking appliances, and running errands move time forward—but also reveal disturbing evidence that something isn’t right.

Exploration & Discovery
Search rooms, examine objects, and uncover clues that slowly unravel the mystery.

Player Choice Matters
Confront, conceal, or avoid the lurking presence. Every decision has lasting repercussions.

Atmosphere That Shifts
Time and mood alter the environment as you play, turning the mundane into unsettling trials of endurance.

Multiple Endings
Choices made across three nights lead to different conclusions, ensuring no two playthroughs feel the same.

⭐ Wishlist Kuromaku on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3947910/Kuromaku/
